captureCountContract: At least 24 captures; correction-on may add one fit=False verification capture when fitted HTML changes. Aggregate actual captures from fit and verification receipts.
sharingContract: Each author HTML is immutable input shared by correction-off and correction-on branches.
comparisonContract: Compare prompt arms only within the same source sample; compare correction off/on only from the same generated HTML.

qualityAggregation.promptEffect: aggregate same-sample baseline versus improved prompt separately
qualityAggregation.correctionEffect: aggregate off versus on from shared generated HTML separately
qualityAggregation.historicalComparison: do not compare directly with the previous failure ratio

timingContract.trialBoundary: author entry through completion of both branches' final inspection
timingContract.rule: Persist uninterrupted trial start/end and each phase start/end/duration. Do not label additive phase estimates as monotonic completion latency.
